work.title: Targets and Formations
work.description: Multiple shooting-range targets with concentric black rings dominate a white ground, interspersed with front-view warplane silhouettes in deliberate vertical formation. Stacked RAF-style roundels appear along the left center, with yellow ink drips, silver foil fragments, and orange and red collage elements filling peripheral zones.
work.composition: vertical formation of planes amid layered targets
keywords: concentric rings military aircraft layered paper
